maria.g: quick follow-up to the quant RFCi prototyped a tiny observability payload for quant artifacts (fp8/int8/4bit) so oncall can triage regressions. can i get a fast sanity check?
samir: sure. top-level question: attach to profile only or to model+profile+route?
maria.g: model+profile+route. need route to attribute customer regressions.
li: use snake_case, add event_id and severity bucket (low/medium/high).
aj: ops ask: include compact json example and prometheus-friendly labels for metrics export.
maria.g: demo payload (redacted): {model: redwood-v2-medium, profile_id: fp8-aggressive-2026-07, profile_version: 1, route: /chat/generate, event_id: evt-20260701-01, bucket: high, degrade_score: 0.83, fidelity_budget: 0.12, quality_anchor: qa_v1, anchor_examples: [weather_short], token_index: 18, residual_norm: 0.038, kv_mismatch: false, sample_output_snippet: "[redacted] less specific", redaction_flag: true, metadata_ttl_seconds: 1209600, sample_ttl_seconds: 604800, explainability_collected: false, explainability_uri: "", collect_cost_ms: 0.5, collect_size_bytes: 20480}
ops-bot: /observe quant-artifacts --since 1h --degrade_score>0.75 --group-by route,model
samir: heavy Q: collect token-level explainability when degrade_score>0.85? useful but costly.
maria.g: gated opt-in for canaries/customers. default false; explainability_uri present when collected; retrieval admin-only.
li: add artifact_resolution event with resolution_reason enum {rollout_rollback, profile_tweak, false_positive, noop} and resolver_name + notes.
aj: ensure redaction pipeline removes PII from sample_output_snippet and include estimated cost numbers in the docs.
maria.g: will open PR with schema (snake_case), console mockups, backend shim, runbook (redaction, TTLs, admin access), and microbench numbers. tagging reviewers.
ops-bot: maria.g mentioned samir, li, aj in #eng-ml
